_comment: Houston events collector settings. center/radius/lookahead drive Ticketmaster and SeatGeek queries and the event window. 'feeds' are the enabled free feeds (type: tribe = WordPress The Events Calendar REST, ics = iCalendar URL). 'candidates' are never run; to try one, copy it into 'feeds' and set enabled true. maxPerSeries (default 8; a feed may override it with its own maxPerSeries) keeps only the next N occurrences of each recurring series from the free feeds; maxEventsPerSource (default 600) is the per-feed safeguard (soonest events kept, warning in status.json).
_watchlistComment: Keywords queried every run against Ticketmaster (keyword=) and SeatGeek (q=) in the same area/window; matches are tagged event.watch and merged with the normal results. Matching is the sources' own fuzzy search, so use specific names. Empty by default. Examples (not active; copy into the watchlist array to enable): "Whose Live Anyway", "Cullen Performance Hall", "Improv Houston".
